finding: The entity model lacks attributes that the Scenarios and contracts use. GATE_ENTRY holds name, enabled and threshold, but RL-09 and the gates schema use command and timeout_minutes, and GATE_CONFIG does not hold the scalars attempts and attempts_escalated. The DISPATCH_LEDGER entry names status, wave, tier, attempts, commit_sha and attempt_grants, but the area spec Scenarios use escalation_granted, the reason of a blocked entry, branch, and worktree. No entity holds the review report with story, run and branch_head, which BR-122 and the premerge-check contract read. Add these attributes, and add a review report entity or link to report-format.md. Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: dispatch-contract.md and interface-contracts.md list each field, so an implementer can act (no to fails_purpose); a reader of the entity model must look up three other files to find the fields that the Scenarios check (raises_cost).
